sheetCoverage: Four reference-extracted eight-frame Bakunawa skill atlases (Abyssal Roar, Tidal Cataclysm, Maelstrom Prison, Stormfang Lightning) run in the boss attack phases. Boss idle motion, water ambience, player spells, and lighting remain procedural. Boss defeat now plays a 5.65-second cinematic using existing Yhannie combat poses and procedural magic/water effects, with Bakunawa visible through the finishing hit and sink.
